description: This file defines the 'Theme' class, which represents a theme in the PhpSpreadsheet library's Xlsx reader. It manages theme names, colour schemes, and colour mappings used in spreadsheet themes.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A class encapsulating theme-related properties and methods for handling spreadsheet themes, including theme name, colour scheme, and colour map.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Theme object with provided theme name, colour scheme, and colour map.

methods.name: getColourByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the colour value at the specified index in the colour map.
